# ARDN Cloud Solutions

> ARDN Cloud Solutions is an Orlando, Florida-based team that builds custom AI applications and a suite of Salesforce-native cloud products, backed by 30+ years of combined Salesforce design, build, and deployment experience. We design, build, host, and operate software for one predictable monthly fee — standalone, alongside Salesforce, or wherever your business runs.

## Products & Services

- [AI Forge](https://ardncloudsolutions.com/ai-forge): Custom AI applications built and run for you. Our Florida-based team designs, builds, hosts, and continuously improves bespoke AI apps for one monthly subscription — live in 2–6 weeks. New customers get the one-time custom build free and pay only the monthly subscription.
- [Storefronts](https://ardncloudsolutions.com/storefronts): Salesforce-native ecommerce — products, memberships, subscriptions, events, and ticketing without leaving Salesforce.
- [Salesforce Payments](https://ardncloudsolutions.com/salesforce-payments): Quote-to-cash inside Salesforce — branded checkout, real-time status, and automated reconciliation.
- [License Guard](https://ardncloudsolutions.com/license-guard): Salesforce-native tool that detects and reclaims unused Salesforce licenses, typically paying back its annual cost within a quarter.
- [AI-Powered Support (ReplyCX)](https://ardncloudsolutions.com/ai-powered-support): No-code AI agents that automate roughly 70% of routine customer queries across WhatsApp, email, live chat, and social — in one inbox.
- [Membership Management](https://ardncloudsolutions.com/membership-management): A flexible membership platform for gyms, YMCAs, studios, clubs, and associations — recurring billing, class scheduling, attendance, and a branded member portal.
